title: Circular - Email My Case Status - Subscription from Gujarat High Court Case Status website
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
CIRCULAR
Date: 7th June, 2021
Subject: Link for Online subscription to Email My Case Status
service from the High Court website
“Email My Case Status” service of High Court of Gujarat is a unique litigant
and lawyer centric service developed as per the guidance and directions of
Honourable the Chief Justice of High Court of Gujarat Mr. Justice Vikram Nath. By
subscribing to this free of cost service, updates of any case of High Court of Gujarat
or any District/Taluka Courts are automatically emailed to anyone who subscribes
for the same. This service can be availed using a mobile number and email
address, by sending SMS in prescribed format. Detailed features of the service are
demonstrated in videos available on High Court Youtube channel in English as well
as Gujarati at https://www.youtube.com/c/GujaratHighCourtLive.
In addition to the SMS method to subscribe for this service, as directed by
Honourable the Chief Justice, a direct subscription link is being launched today on
the Case Status display of each of the case, to facilitate direct online subscription to
‘Email My Case Status’ service for getting current status and future updates of the
particular case through automated emails.
Upon clicking the ‘Email My Case Status’
button, Mobile Number and Email Address of
the subscriber are to be updated
as given in the image on the right.
On confirmation of the SMS OTP
and email verification OTP (email
verification only if new subscriber
to this service), email updates will
be started of the particular case,
from next court working day
onwards.
Sd/-
REGISTRAR GENERAL
